versions.description_html:
Learn how Azure Machine Learning simplifies building, training, and deploying ML models in the cloud. Demystify workspaces, data, compute, and MLOps.

Machine learning is a program that finds patterns in examples instead of following rules a person wrote by hand. That's the whole idea.In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Machine Learning Really Is
  • What Azure Machine Learning Actually Does
  • The Workspace
  • Data and Compute
  • Building a Model
  • Turning It Into Predictions
  • Keeping It Working
  • What You'd Actually Build
  • Recap and One Question
Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Build Machine Learning Models in Microsoft Fabric
  • Build a Governed Microsoft 365 Copilot Learning Center
  • More AI & Copilot episodes on M365.FM
